name: Verapimod
description: Selective JAK1 inhibitor for moderate-to-severe rheumatoid arthritis.
mechanismOfAction: Competitive inhibition of Janus kinase 1, blocking downstream STAT phosphorylation and cytokine signaling.

name: Solantrinib
description: Oral BTK inhibitor under evaluation for relapsed/refractory mantle cell lymphoma.
mechanismOfAction: Irreversible covalent binding to Bruton tyrosine kinase, blocking B-cell receptor signaling.

name: Cerulastat
description: Novel amyloid-beta aggregation inhibitor for early Alzheimer's disease.
mechanismOfAction: Small-molecule inhibitor that binds soluble amyloid-beta oligomers and prevents fibril formation.

name: Brivodelta
description: GLP-1 receptor agonist for glycemic control in type 2 diabetes.
mechanismOfAction: Agonizes GLP-1 receptors, enhancing glucose-dependent insulin secretion and slowing gastric emptying.

name: Trenovax
description: mRNA-based prophylactic vaccine candidate against RSV in older adults.
mechanismOfAction: Lipid nanoparticle-encapsulated mRNA encoding pre-fusion RSV F protein, eliciting neutralizing antibodies.

name: Omarigil
description: PDE4 inhibitor for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) exacerbation reduction.
mechanismOfAction: Inhibits phosphodiesterase-4, increasing cAMP in inflammatory cells and reducing cytokine release.

name: Neladomide
description: KRAS G12C covalent inhibitor; program halted after interim efficacy analysis.
mechanismOfAction: Covalently locks KRAS G12C in the GDP-bound inactive state, blocking MAPK pathway signaling.

name: Falurestat
description: SGLT2 inhibitor indicated for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
mechanismOfAction: Blocks sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 in proximal renal tubules, promoting glycosuria and natriuresis.

name: Ixenpril
description: Antisense oligonucleotide targeting PCSK9 for homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia.
mechanismOfAction: RNase H-mediated degradation of PCSK9 mRNA, increasing hepatic LDL receptor expression.

name: Quasimodol
description: IL-23 p19 monoclonal antibody for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.
mechanismOfAction: Selectively binds the p19 subunit of interleukin-23, inhibiting Th17 pathway activation.

name: Renastatin
description: Orally bioavailable NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitor for gout flares and cryopyrin-associated syndromes.
mechanismOfAction: Binds the NACHT domain of NLRP3, preventing inflammasome assembly and IL-1β maturation.

name: Valocorin
description: Factor Xa inhibitor for prevention of stroke and systemic embolism in atrial fibrillation.
mechanismOfAction: Direct, reversible inhibition of activated factor X, reducing thrombin generation.
